authors.description: Only keep posts submitted by one of these usernames (bare name or u/-prefixed, case-insensitive). Leave empty to keep posts from all authors.
authors.title: Only posts by these authors

commentSort.description: How to sort the comment threads.
commentSort.title: Sort comments by

contentContains.description: Only keep self (text) posts whose body contains this text (case-insensitive substring match). Link/image/video posts have no body text and are excluded when this is set. Leave empty to keep all posts.
contentContains.title: Post text contains keyword

domain.description: Only keep posts whose link domain contains this text (case-insensitive, e.g. 'youtube.com' or 'self.python'). Leave empty to keep all domains.
domain.title: Domain contains

excludeAuthors.description: Drop posts submitted by any of these usernames (bare name or u/-prefixed, case-insensitive) — useful for filtering out bots (e.g. AutoModerator) or known spam accounts. Leave empty to keep posts from all authors.
excludeAuthors.title: Exclude posts by these authors

excludeCrossposts.description: When enabled, posts that are crossposts from another subreddit are dropped from the results, keeping only original submissions to the scraped subreddit.
excludeCrossposts.title: Exclude crossposts

excludeDeletedAuthor.description: When enabled, posts whose author account was deleted (shown as [deleted]/[removed]) are dropped from the results.
excludeDeletedAuthor.title: Exclude posts with a deleted/removed author

excludeKeywords.description: Drop posts whose title, self-text body or flair contains any of these keywords or phrases (case-insensitive substring match) — useful for filtering out megathreads, giveaways or spam boilerplate. Leave empty to keep all posts.
excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords

excludeSpoilers.description: When enabled, posts marked as a spoiler by their author are dropped from the results.
excludeSpoilers.title: Exclude spoiler-tagged posts

excludeStickied.description: When enabled, posts pinned/stickied by moderators (e.g. rules, weekly threads) are dropped from the results.
excludeStickied.title: Exclude stickied/pinned posts

flairContains.description: Only keep posts whose flair text contains this text (case-insensitive substring match). Leave empty to keep all flairs.
flairContains.title: Flair contains keyword

fullSubreddit.description: When enabled, walk Reddit's 'new' listing as deep as the source allows (roughly 1,000 posts per listing) instead of stopping at the first page. Combine with a higher 'Maximum posts per subreddit'.
fullSubreddit.title: Full subreddit mode (deepest reachable history)

includeComments.description: When enabled, the full comment thread (including nested replies) is collected for every scraped post. Significantly increases run time and output.
includeComments.title: Include comments for each post

includeNSFW.description: Include posts Reddit explicitly flags as NSFW. Posts in 18+ communities are served by the actor's adult-content cookie and are not distinguishable at community level.
includeNSFW.title: Include NSFW (18+) content

maxComments.description: Only keep posts with at most this many comments. Useful for finding under-discussed posts. Leave unset to keep all posts.
maxComments.title: Maximum number of comments

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of comments to scrape per post (only used when 'Include comments' is enabled).
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Maximum comments per post

maxContentLength.description: Only keep self (text) posts whose body is at most this many characters long. Leave unset to keep all lengths.
maxContentLength.title: Maximum post body length (characters)

maxItems.description: Global safety cap on the total number of records pushed for the whole run (posts and comments combined).
maxItems.title: Maximum total items (safety cap)

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to keep from each subreddit after filters. Reddit serves roughly 1,000 posts per hot/new listing and about 500 for top/controversial.
maxPosts.title: Maximum posts per subreddit

maxScore.description: Only keep posts with a score at or below this value. Useful for finding overlooked/low-visibility posts. Leave unset to keep all scores.
maxScore.title: Maximum score (upvotes minus downvotes)

minAwards.description: Only keep posts with at least this many total awards. Leave unset to keep all posts.
minAwards.title: Minimum awards received

minComments.description: Only keep posts with at least this many comments. Leave unset to keep all posts.
minComments.title: Minimum number of comments

minContentLength.description: Only keep self (text) posts whose body is at least this many characters long. Link/image/video posts have no body and are excluded when this is set. Useful for dropping one-line/low-effort text posts when building NLP datasets. Leave unset to keep all lengths.
minContentLength.title: Minimum post body length (characters)

minScore.description: Only keep posts with a score at or above this value. Leave unset to keep all scores.
minScore.title: Minimum score (upvotes minus downvotes)

minUpvoteRatio.description: Only keep posts whose upvote ratio (fraction of votes that are upvotes, 0-1) is at or above this value. Useful for filtering out controversial/divisive posts. Leave unset to keep all ratios.
minUpvoteRatio.title: Minimum upvote ratio

onlyWithFlair.description: When enabled, posts without a flair tag are dropped from the results.
onlyWithFlair.title: Only posts that have a flair

postType.description: Keep only posts of the selected content type (based on Reddit's listing type). Leave unset to keep all types. Legacy 'self' is treated as 'text'.
postType.title: Only posts of this type

postedAfter.description: Only keep posts created on or after this date (UTC). When set, collection runs newest-first (sort=new) and the sort option above is ignored. Reddit caps each listing at roughly 1,000 posts, so a distant date window on a very active subreddit may not be fully reachable.
postedAfter.title: Posts created on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)

postedBefore.description: Only keep posts created on or before this date (interpreted as the end of that day, UTC).
postedBefore.title: Posts created on or before (YYYY-MM-DD)

sort.description: How to sort posts in the subreddit. Reddit serves roughly 1,000 posts per hot/new listing and about 500 for top/controversial.
sort.title: Sort posts by

subreddits.description: List of subreddits to scrape. Accepts bare names (python), r/ prefixed (r/python) or full URLs (https://www.reddit.com/r/python/).
subreddits.title: Subreddits

timeFilter.description: Time filter when sorting by 'top' or 'controversial'.
timeFilter.title: Time filter (for 'top' and 'controversial' sort)

titleContains.description: Only keep posts whose title contains this text (case-insensitive substring match). Leave empty to keep all titles.
titleContains.title: Title contains keyword
